issues.evidence: Hero 'on the real laptop' frame at 92.5 shows no laptop at all: a cropped Changes panel, a teal slide edge with a cut-off '3 / 26 outlook', and an orange smear filling the right third. Measured sharp 131 vs 280-598 on neighbours.
issues.suggested_action: Open WIDE on the warm-room laptop (35mm, f/2.8, lamp key frame-left) for 1 s, then push to the panel; never let the orange spill occupy more than a rim on frame-right.

issues.evidence: At 5.0 she is at an office desk in a striped shirt under a blue practical; at 7.5 'her' hands type on a laptop on a bed/couch with a pillow and dark knit sleeves - different set, different wardrobe.
issues.suggested_action: Use a top-down insert shot in an office desk set with striped cuffs, or cut to a side-angle insert from the same desk clip; at minimum crop out the pillow and sleeves.

issues.evidence: Top-down laptop composites (7.5, 12.5, 57.5, 60) render the screen as a radial white bloom brighter in the centre than any real panel, with the UI barely readable; reads as a spotlight, not an emissive display.
issues.suggested_action: Flatten the screen falloff to <15% centre-to-edge, drop screen gain ~1 stop, and add a faint keyboard spill instead of a centre bloom.

issues.evidence: Hands-typing insert at 15.6 is fully defocused (measured sharpness 1.2); also 22.97 (1.8), 24.07 (3.2), 44.57 (2.3), 107.3 (3.5).
issues.suggested_action: Rack to sharp on the fingers within the first 8 frames, or replace with an in-focus 85mm insert; deliberate defocus should resolve, not stay mush.

issues.evidence: Illustrated UI (0, 10, 17.5, 25, 27.5, 35, 42.5) is a flat, front-on screenshot under a vignette, centred, no depth plane or light; 35.0 is a slide strip floating on black.
issues.suggested_action: Put each illustrated window on a monitor plane in her office (slight 8-12 degree yaw, foreground bokeh of her desk lamp), or at least a parallax layer of the room behind.

issues.evidence: 'Bring in your team.' (85, 87.5) and 'You decide what lands.' (90) sit on top of toolbar/UI text top-left, both readable only through a dark box.
issues.suggested_action: Move supers to the empty lower-left negative space or the bokeh field; reserve a clean third for type.

issues.evidence: The head-in-hands stock shot at 22.5 and the 'scratches head' insert at 30.0 are the same framing, same teal map background, same pose.
issues.suggested_action: Replace 30.0 with a different size/angle (profile CU against the monitor glow, 85mm) so the second beat escalates.

issues.evidence: Lights-come-on beat: 107.5 and 110 are the same candle-warm exposure; no visible change of motivated light between frames.
issues.suggested_action: Start the shot in true darkness with only screen key, then cut the practical lamp on so the room gains ~2 stops.

constraint_failures.rule: identity or set flip across a cut
constraint_failures.evidence: office desk + striped shirt -> bed/couch + dark knit sleeves for the same protagonist
hero laptop never visible; cropped panel + orange smear

top_revision: Re-frame the 91.8 hero as a true wide of the warm-room laptop pushing to the Changes panel, so the film's payoff shot actually shows the product in a place.
